crossRefs.note: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

parallels.note: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

translations.web: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, those who had seen it reported how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
translations.kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
translations.asv: And they that saw it told them how he that was possessed with demons was made whole.
